crossRefs.note: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.
that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be…
that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.
Also, prepare a guest room for me, for I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

translations.web: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.
translations.bsb: And I especially urge you to pray that I may be restored to you soon.
translations.kjv: But I beseech you the rather to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
translations.asv: And I exhort you the more exceedingly to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.
